TypeLeast：按一下，说话。再按一下，文字写到光标处。

## 本次更新 / What is new

<!-- typeleast-update:zh -->
- Mac：Chrome、Edge 里也能贴回开始听写时的光标位置。
- 点了网页空白处或另一个输入框，文字仍贴回原处；换了标签页则留在历史里。
<!-- /typeleast-update -->

<!-- typeleast-update:en -->
- Mac: in Chrome and Edge, text also goes where the cursor was when you started.
- A click on a blank part of the page or another field no longer moves it; after a tab switch it stays in History.
<!-- /typeleast-update -->
